results.sql: SELECT specialty, SUM(nbrx) AS nbrx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY specialty LIMIT 500
SELECT rep_id, SUM(calls) AS total_calls FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY rep_id ORDER BY total_calls ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT plan_id FROM v_payer_access WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY plan_id HAVING SUM(rejected) > 50) LIMIT 500
SELECT payer_name, SUM(trx) AS total_prescriptions FROM v_hcp_rx GROUP BY payer_name LIMIT 500
SELECT month, SUM(vae_opened) * 1.0 / SUM(vae_sent) AS vae_open_rate FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY month LIMIT 500
SELECT rep_id, SUM(vae_sent) AS total_vae_sent FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY rep_id LIMIT 500
SELECT SUM(trx) AS total_trx FROM v_hcp_rx WHERE is_ours = TRUE AND week_start > CAST('2025-12-29' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '28' DAY LIMIT 500
SELECT payer_name, SUM(rejected) * 1.0 / SUM(submitted) AS reject_rate FROM v_payer_access WHERE is_ours = TRUE GROUP BY payer_name LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT hcp_id FROM v_hcp_activity GROUP BY hcp_id HAVING SUM(calls) >= 5) LIMIT 500
SELECT SUM(calls) AS total_calls FROM v_hcp_activity WHERE specialty = 'Rheumatology' LIMIT 500
